Its services extend to urban infrastructure development, commercial and residential buildings, and irrigation projects.

BALLARPUR.NS.d: Ballarpur Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, and exports writing and printing paper, and pulp products in India and internationally. It provides writing and printing papers comprising coated and uncoated wood-free papers, copier papers, and creamwove papers; tissue papers; rayon grade pulp; and specialty papers, such as water marked bond, ledger, cartridge, envelope, super printing, and matrix multipurpose papers, as well as food packaging products.

BFINVEST.NS.d: BF Investment Limited operates as a non deposit taking core investment company in India. It is involved in the loans and investments business. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Pune, India.

BHAGCHEM.NS.d: Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited is an Indian company that produces and sells agrochemicals. Its products include insecticides such as chlorpyrifos, fipronil and imidacloprid, the fungicide azoxystrobin, herbicides like triclopyr, and intermediates such as 2,6-dichloroaniline. It also provides contract manufacturing services.

BHARATRAS.NS.d: Bharat Rasayan Limited manufactures and sells technical grade pesticides, intermediates, and bulk formulations in India. It offers insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and plant growth regulators. The company also exports its products. Bharat Rasayan Limited was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

BSL.NS.d: BSL Limited, a textile company, manufactures and sells fabrics and yarns in India and internationally. The company operates through Textile and Wind Power segments. It produces a range of polyester viscose fabrics, including suiting, shirting, safari, and corduroy blends; worsted fabrics, such as wool, wool rich, lycra blended poly wool, poly viscose, mohair polyester wool, and polyester silk wool fabrics.

CSM.NS.d: CSM Technologies Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker CSM and traded in INR. Its country is India.

DWARKESH.NS.d: Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited, an integrated conglomerate, manufactures and sells sugar and allied products in India and internationally. It is also involved in the co-generation of power, and manufacture of industrial alcohol and ethanol. The company was formerly known as Dwarka Sugar Limited and changed its name to Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited in 1994. Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.

FINEORG.NS.d: Fine Organic Industries Limited manufactures and sells oleochemical-based additives in India and internationally. The company offers food additives, such as emulsifiers, anti-fungal agents, and other specialty additives; and plastic additives, including disperse agents, slip agents, anti-stats, lubricants, antifogging, processing aids, anti-stats, and flow improvers additives. It also provides additives for rubber, cosmetics and pharmaceutical, paints and inks, textiles, and other industries.

FIRSTCRY.NS.d: Brainbees Solutions Limited operates a multi-channel retail platform for products for mothers, babies and kids in India and internationally. Its categories include fashion, footwear, toys, diapering and gear, feeding and bath products, nursery products, health and safety, women's beauty and maternity products.

GRPLTD.NS.d: GRP Limited manufactures and sells reclaim rubber sheets for tire and non-tire rubber goods industries in India and internationally. It operates through Reclaim Rubber and Others segments. The company offers reclaim rubber products, such as natural rubber reclaim, synthetic rubber reclaim, and polycoat rubber for use in inner liners and tubes, tire side walls and piles, tire treads and retreads, conveyor belts, moulded goods, adhesives, and footwear, as well as rubber mattings, profiles, and roofing.

GULPOLY.NS.d: Gulshan Polyols Limited engages in the mineral processing, grain processing, and distillary businesses in India and internationally. The company provides starch sugar products, such as sorbitol 70% solution, dextrose monohydrate, malto dextrine powder, and liquid glucose, as well as rice fructose syrups, brown rice syrups, and rice syrup solids; organic sweeteners; and activated, precipitated, and ground calcium carbonate products.

GVPIL.NS.d: GE Power India Limited provides services for power generation plants and equipment, including design, procurement, manufacturing, construction, maintenance and servicing in India and internationally. Its products include hydro and gas power systems, automation and control technology, air quality control systems, grinding mills and boilers.

HAMPTON.NS.d: Hampton Sky Realty Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker HAMPTON and traded in INR. Its country is India.

HATHWAY.NS.d: Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited provides cable television network, Internet, and allied services. It operates through Broadband Business and Cable Television Segments. The company offers digital cable TV services; standard definition (SD) and high definition (HD) cable TV channel services; and SD and HD set-top boxes. It also provides home and business broadband services.

HIRECT.NS.d: Hirect Limited, designs, manufactures, and markets semi-conductor devices, power electronic equipment, and railway transportation equipment in India and internationally. It offers power supplies for electrostatic precipitators; DC power systems for electrochemical plants; chargers and regenerative dischargers for the battery industry; water cooled rectifier systems; and cathodic protection transformer rectifier units.

IRB.NS.d: IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited engages in the construction, development, and operation and maintenance of roads and highways on build-operate-transfer (BOT) basis in India. The company operates in two segments, BOT/ Toll Operate and Transfer Projects, and Construction. It is also involved in real estate development; generation and sale of electricity through windmill; and hospitality and airport infrastructure activities. The company has 21 projects with 12,317 lane kilometers of roads and highways.

JSWCEMENT.NS.d: JSW Cement Ltd. is an Indian producer of construction materials marketed as environmentally conscious. Its range includes clinker, ready-mix concrete, construction chemicals, Ordinary Portland Cement, Portland Slag Cement and GGBS (ground granulated blast furnace slag), and it has a significant position in the GGBS segment.

KENNAMET.NS.d: Kennametal India Limited, together with its subsidiary, manufactures and trades in hard metal products and machine tools in India, Europe, the United States, China, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Hard Metal Products and Machining Solutions Group.

KHAITANLTD.NS.d: Khaitan (India) Limited manufactures and trades in sugar in India. The company operates through Marketing, Sugar, and Agriculture divisions. The company also trades in electrical products, fans, appliances, wires, cables and pumps, lighting products, etc.; and cultivates sugarcane. It offers its products under the Khaitan brand. The company was formerly known as Khaitan Agro Complex Limited and changed its name to Khaitan (India) Limited in 1994.

KNACK.NS.d: Knack Packaging Ltd. is a packaging solutions provider that makes pinch bottom bags and PLWPP bags, meaning printed and laminated woven polypropylene bags. Its products also include HDPE and PP tapes and woven fabrics, woven bags, and BOPP laminated PP woven bags in pinch bottom and block bottom formats.

LUPIN.NS.d: Lupin Limited, a pharmaceutical company, manufactures and distributes a range of branded and generic formulations, biotechnology products, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and specialty products in India, the United States, Japan, and internationally. The company offers formulations for use in the therapeutic areas of cardiovascular, diabetology, asthma, pediatrics, central nervous system, gastro-intestinal, anti-infective, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug therapy, anti-TB, and cephalosporin.

MAKS.NS.d: Maks Energy Solutions India Ltd. manufactures, supplies, sells, installs, services, and commissions diesel generator sets, marketed under the "Maks Generators" brand, with capacities ranging from 15 kVA to 1250 kVA. The company also engages in the trade and export of spare parts for diesel engines and earth-moving equipment, including accessory drives, cylinder blocks, and metal crankshafts.

MANALIPETC.NS.d: Manali Petrochemicals Limited manufactures and sells petrochemical products primarily in India and internationally. It offers propylene oxide, an input material for the propylene glycol and polyether polyol derivative products; and flexible slabstock, flexible cold cure, rigid, and elastomer grade polyols used for various applications in automobile, refrigeration and temperature control, adhesive, sealant, coating, furniture, and textile industries.

MATRIMONY.NS.d: Matrimony.com Limited online matchmaking services on internet and mobile platforms in India and internationally. The company operates through Matchmaking Services and Marriage Services segments.

MAZDOCK.NS.d: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited engages in building and repairing of ships, submarines, vessels and related engineering products in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Shipbuilding and Submarine.

NOVARTIND.NS.d: Novartis India Limited primarily trades in drugs and pharmaceuticals. The company offers pharmaceutical products in the areas of bone and pain, calcium portfolio, gynecology, and neurosciences. It also provides generics medicines for anti-TB, anti-infective, and gynecology; and tyrosine kinase inhibitor for cancer under Glive brand name, as well as eye care products.

PANSARI.NS.d: Pansari Developers Limited is an Indian real estate developer building residential and commercial properties, mainly in the Kolkata metropolitan area and surrounding parts of West Bengal. All its projects are sold under the Purti name. It was founded in 1996.

PENTAGOLD-SM.NS.d: PENTA GOLD LTD is involved in the business of dealing in precious metals, including gold. The company's activities include trading, processing, and potentially manufacturing gold products. Specific operational details may require further research.

PPL.NS.d: Prakash Pipes Limited manufactures and supplies PVC pipes and fittings, and packaging products in India. The company offers unplasticised PVC (uPVC) pipes; casing pipes; plumbing uPVC pipes; column pipes; soil waste rain pipes; and uPVC fittings, as well as flexible packaging products, such as barrier films and laminates.

PREMEXPLN.NS.d: Premier Explosives Limited manufactures and sells high energy materials. The company offers bulk explosives, packaged explosives, detonators, detonating fuse, cast and emulsion boosters, solid propellants, pyrogen igniters, pyro devices, explosive bolts, pyro actuators, smoke markers, cable cutters, etc. that have applications in mining, infrastructure, defence, space, homeland security, and other areas. The company also operates and maintains solid propellant plants of defence and space establishments.

PRSMJOHNSN.NS.d: Prism Johnson Limited, an integrated building materials company, provides cement, ready-mixed concrete, ceramic tiles, and bathroom products in India and internationally. It operates through four segments: Cement, Tile and Bath (HRJ), Ready Mixed Concrete (RMC), and Insurance. The company offers Portland pozzolana cement under the Champion, Champion Plus, Duratech and Ordinary Portland Cement brands. It also provides aggregates; and operates quarries.

PTL.NS.d: PTL Enterprises Limited engages in the lease of plant to Apollo Tyres Limited. The company was formerly known as Premier Tyres Ltd. PTL Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1959 and is based in Gurugram, India. PTL Enterprises Limited is a subsidiary of Sunrays Properties and Investments Co. Pvt Ltd.

PVRINOX.NS.d: PVR INOX Limited is a cinema exhibition company that screens, distributes and produces films. It also runs in-house advertising, food and beverage sales, gaming and restaurants, with operations in India and Sri Lanka. It was incorporated in 1995 as PVR Limited.

RCOM.NS.d: Reliance Communications Limited provides enterprise voice, data, video, and IT infrastructure solutions to enterprises, over-the-top (OTT) players, and network operators in India and internationally. It offers business Internet, network, cloud networking, data center, enterprise voice, cloud telephony, and access number services; and collaboration services, which include audio and Web conferencing, as well as voice and various value-added wholesaling services for carriers and service providers.

SANDESH.NS.d: The Sandesh Limited engages in editing, printing, and publishing newspapers and periodicals in India. It publishes SANDESH, a premier Gujarati daily newspaper; and Sandesh Pratyaksha Panchang, a periodical. The company also operates Sandesh News, a Gujarati news channel; Spotlight, an out of home media solution; and a Gujarati news app. The Sandesh Limited was founded in 1923 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

SARVESHWAR-SM.NS.d: SARVESHWAR FOODS L is an Indian company involved in the processing and marketing of branded and unbranded basmati rice. The company is based in Jammu & Kashmir, India.

SHBAJRG.NS.d: Shri Bajrang Alliance Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SHBAJRG and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SPECIALITY.NS.d: Speciality Restaurants Limited owns and operates restaurant outlets and sweet shops in India. The company operates its restaurants under the Mainland China, Oh! Calcutta, Asia Kitchen by Mainland China, Sigree, Sigree Global Grill, Flame & Grill, Café Mezzuna, Hoppipola, Gong Modern Asian, POH, Spicery by Sigree, Jungle Safari, Haka, Machaan, and Zoodles brand names; and confectionaries and cafes under the Sweet Bengal and Dariole brands, as well as bars under the Hay and Episode One brands.

STARTECK.NS.d: Starteck Finance Limited is an India-based non-banking financial institution offering financing to individuals, small and medium-sized enterprises and larger businesses in urban and semi-urban areas. It dates from 1985 and took its present name in November 2018, having earlier traded under a different name.

STYRENIX.NS.d: Styrenix Performance Materials Limited is an Indian company that produces, markets and distributes engineering thermoplastics. Its products include Absolac, a resin for home appliances, electronic enclosures and automotive parts inside and outside the vehicle, and Absolan, used in industrial goods, cosmetic packaging and stationery.

SUDARCOLOR.NS.d: Sudarshan Colorants India Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SUDARCOLOR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SUPRIYA.NS.d: Supriya Lifescience Limited researches, develops, makes and sells pharmaceutical chemicals and bulk drugs around the world. Its active pharmaceutical ingredients span the anti-gout, anti-malarial, vitamin, anti-hypertensive, analgesic, decongestant, anti-asthmatic, anti-allergic and antihistamine areas, as well as oncology, veterinary and general products.

SWASTIKAIN.NS.d: Swastika Infra Ltd. is an EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) company that executes power distribution infrastructure projects and trades in the electrical field. It was founded on 6 August 2019 and has its head office in Jaipur, India.

TREL.NS.d: Transindia Real Estate Limited is a Mumbai-based property company that develops and rents out real estate assets, including warehousing facilities, logistics hubs, commercial properties and land parcels. It also offers engineering solutions and equipment rental, and was formerly known under another name.

TRIDENT.NS.d: Trident Limited manufactures, trades in, and sells textiles, papers, and chemicals in the United States, India, and internationally. It provides cotton, blended yarn, special open end yarn, organic cotton, core spun yarns, Eli-twist yarn, compact yarn, slub yarn, and a range of value added yarns, such as melanges, package dyed, gassed mercerized yarn, zero twist, wrapper yarn, bamboo/cotton, modal/cotton, soya/cotton, polyester/cotton, BCI cotton, BMP cotton, and dyed yarns; bath linens, bath mats, and bath rugs;…

VALIANTORG.NS.d: Valiant Organics Limited, a chemical manufacturing company, manufactures and markets specialty chemicals in India. Its products include para chlorophenol; ortho chlorophenol; 2,4 di-chlorophenol; 2,4,6 tri- chlorophenol; 2,6 di-chlorophenol; and para nitroaniline.

VASCONEQ.NS.d: Vascon Engineers Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services in India. It operates through EPC, Real Estate Development, and Manufacturing & Building Management System (BMS) segments. The company constructs residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, hospitals, and hospitality; and develops residential properties, hotel premises, industrial parks, retail malls and schools, and community welfare centres. It also manufactures clean room partitions and BMS.

VMARCIND-SM.NS.d: V MARC INDIA LTD is an Indian apparel company involved in manufacturing and exporting readymade garments. They produce a variety of clothing items for both domestic and international markets. The company is based in India.

VSCL-SM.NS.d: Vadivarhe Speciality Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells organic chemicals, intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients, personal care products, and specialty chemicals in India and internationally.

WAKEFIT.NS.d: Wakefit Innovations Ltd. makes and sells home furnishing products. Its range includes pillows, bedding, beds and mattresses for sleep, sofa sets, wardrobes, office chairs, study tables and coffee tables as furniture, and towels as home textiles.
